seed_learnings.content: This design system uses semantic Tailwind tokens (bg-primary-500, text-muted-foreground, bg-destructive) rather than raw palette classes (bg-blue-500, text-gray-500) or hardcoded hex colors. Reference tokens exclusively, never bg-[#hex].

criteria: src/utils/math.ts exports a clamp(n, min, max) function that correctly clamps n between min and max.
